title: Left finite scalar quotient formula
statement:
theorem left_quotient_formula_exists
    (b : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙ leftComplex l E L ι g ≅
      (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙ rightComplex l E L ι g)
    (hb : CompletedFormula l E L ι g b) :
    ∃ vleft : ∀ n : ℕ,
        (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙ leftComplex l E L ι g ⟶
          (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙ restrictedLeft l E L ι g n,
      LeftQuotientFormula l E L ι g vleft

proof.text: Construct the left quotient map by unit insertion and finite projection, and verify its pure-tensor formula. The concrete presentation transport is isolated to this left component.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03EK and 03EL; independent left/right component of the finite quotient construction.
